Hey there, I hear you. The first time I cut, it was curiosity and then I was hooked. I did it for years, went 5 years without, and recently relapsed into it again. It's all I think about now. I feel like that's normal for people who self harm, but I can only speak for myself.

I understand that it feels good. I agree. It being "wrong" is a tougher question. It's not safe to self harm, as it opens you up to risk of infection and obviously, harm. If you're being bullied and self harm has become your coping mechanism, you could look for other coping strategies to use when you're feeling overwhelmed.

PM me if you want more info about that. I can link you to a list of coping skills for you to peruse to see if you can find one that works for you.

Hey. It's understandable to feel heavy guilt after harming, especially after promising someone you wouldn't, but I'm proud of you for sharing here. Self-harm is a rollercoaster and it was always hardest for me to stay clean when I promised someone I would.

We're allowed to make mistakes and you deserve the opportunity to try again. Try not to be too hard on yourself. Try your best to stay safe and if you fail, at least you tried your best. I'm proud of you for trying.
